construct: THE FUNCTION METRICS (owner 2026-10-14, step 2 of the owner's order for The Function section; REA_19): three bars per function on the energy page between the definition and the chips. Two TRAIT bars, one per god of the family, each with a fixed everyday label (the words other astrology and personality apps use) and a height from that god's share of the chart; one STYLE bar with two plain ends and no better end, tilted by the energy's balance against the core. No gloss line per level (owner 2026-10-15: the labels explain themselves; the level glosses retired to retired_gloss). Each bar carries one fixed ask line, the metric defined in one plain question, backlogged for the glossary and not rendered for now. Derived, never written per chart: the engine computes the levels (Elementum_App/src/engine/functionMetrics.js), the words come from this file.
candidate_note: DRAFT 2026-10-14: the fifteen metrics and their lines were agreed with the owner in session (the names, the three-bar balance, the style bars with no better end) and wired into the app on the owner's "start writing and map those into our app artifact and station database"; every gloss line stays provisional until the owner reads it in the app and rules it, line by line, as with every other field. RETIRED 2026-10-15: the owner ruled the level glosses unnecessary (the labels explain themselves, as the MBTI metrics do; a line per level is a reading of the person, which the ledger owns); the seventy-five lines moved to retired_gloss, the bars render static.

catalyst.low: You take pressure when it comes and hand little of it out.
catalyst.mid: In a crisis you get clear, and people notice.
catalyst.high: You are clear in a crisis and others follow, and you went looking for the crisis.

friction.low: You push yourself a little harder than the day asks.
friction.mid: You run yourself hard, and the people near you feel the pace.
friction.high: You run everyone, yourself first, past the point of rest.

catalyst.low: You answer to the rules you chose and leave the rest alone.
catalyst.mid: Your word holds, and people plan on it.
catalyst.high: Your word holds without exception, and people build on it.

friction.low: You take on a duty or two more than you can comfortably carry.
friction.mid: You cannot easily say no to a duty, even an unfair one.
friction.high: You cannot say no to a duty, even a bad one, and it costs you sleep.

flexible_structured.low: You want little structure around you and make the plan as you go.
flexible_structured.mid: You want a frame to work in and room to move inside it.
flexible_structured.high: You want the plan set and the rules clear before you start.
